candidates.name: B0_baseline
candidates.role: Chen2020 baseline stack characterization (native values only) plus the global fully-charged test fixture

candidates.name: V1_porosity_power
candidates.role: power-direction variant: both electrode porosities raised (pos 0.335->0.40, neg 0.25->0.35) to shorten the effective ionic path and raise 4C anode charge acceptance

candidates.name: V2_thin_electrodes
candidates.role: thin-electrode variant (pos 75.6->50 um, neg 85.2->56 um; base thickness ratio ~1.12 kept) to lower DCR and improve 5C/4C rate capability with predicted ~3.3 Ah capacity (still >= 2 Ah)

llm_reason: Power/rate-dominated objective: round 1 spans the two strongest ionic-transport lever families (porosity, electrode thickness) against a bare baseline; charge/discharge heat measured at contract h=10 to expose the raw thermal gap before cooling is sized in round 2 (thermal DoF reserved). All variant values are protocol-managed parameter keys (SKILL 1.5/Stage 3 lists); fixture keys fixed and constant across candidates.
